benchmark_msrv: RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.95.0 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/hyperspatial-msrv cargo bench --offline -p hyperreal --bench legendre_integrals
cache_matrix: The cache-matrix log retains each exact command; --release, no default features, serde, and each of none/f32/f64/both primitive caches; native Legendre and spatial elliptic suites.
clippy_msrv: RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.95.0 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/hyperspatial-msrv cargo clippy --offline -p hyperreal --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
native_msrv: RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.95.0 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/hyperspatial-msrv cargo test --offline -p hyperreal --test legendre_integrals --features serde
opaque_amplitude_matrix: The amplitude-matrix log retains each exact command; expanded unknown-amplitude test in each stable cache configuration and MSRV.
syntax: python3 -m py_compile crates/hyperspatial/scripts/coverage.py crates/hyperspatial/scripts/coverage_common.py crates/hyperspatial/scripts/coverage-gates.py && bash -n scripts/bench-reports.sh && git diff --check
zizmor: UV_TOOL_DIR=/tmp/hyperspatial-uv-tools UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR=/tmp/hyperspatial-uv-bin uv --cache-dir /tmp/hyperspatial-uv-cache tool run --offline zizmor --pedantic --strict-collection .
